summary: Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiaries, Cogent Communications Group, LLC and Cogent Finance, Inc., entered into a First Supplemental Indenture to amend the existing Indenture governing their 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2032. The amendments increase the secured leverage ratio from 4.00:1.00 to 4.75:1.00, require use of proceeds from data center sales to repurchase or retire indebtedness at a discount (at least 50% to repurchase the Notes), restrict use of such proceeds for restricted payments, and prohibit transfer of IRUs to non-guarantor subsidiaries. The Supplemental Indenture was effective upon execution and follows consent from a majority of noteholders. What to watch: impact on leverage and potential bond repurchases.
